# Pocketsfull

> Pocketsfull is a rewards and earning platform where users can earn money by taking paid online surveys, playing free games, and completing offers — then redeem their earnings as gift cards from thousands of global brands across 280+ country-locale markets.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/): Platform overview and getting started
- [Offers](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/offers): Browse all available earning opportunities
- [Earn](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/earn): Overview of ways to earn rewards

## Ways to earn

- [Paid online surveys for money](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/paid-online-surveys-for-money): Take surveys to earn cash rewards
- [Make money playing games](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/make-money-playing-games): Earn by playing partner games
- [Free games](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/free-games): Browse free-to-play games that pay rewards
- [Surveys](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/survey): Available survey opportunities

## Gift cards

- [Online gift cards catalog](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/online-gift-cards): Redeem earnings as gift cards from 8,000+ brands worldwide — including Amazon, Apple, Google Play, Netflix, Spotify, Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Roblox, Uber, Airbnb, Starbucks, Nike, IKEA, H&M, Zara, and thousands of regional retailers, restaurants, airlines, and services.

## Help and information

- [Help Centre](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/help-centre): Support articles and contact options
- [FAQ](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/faq): Frequently asked questions
- [Redeem before](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/redeem-before): Information on reward redemption timing

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/privacy-policy)
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.pocketsfull.com/en-us/terms-and-conditions)

## Notes for LLMs

- The site operates in **281 locale variations** (e.g. `en-us`, `en-in`, `en-gb`, `fr-fr`, `de-de`, `es-es`, `pt-br`, `ja-jp`, `zh-cn`, etc.). Each core page above is available at `/{locale}/{slug}` — for example `/en-in/offers`, `/de-de/offers`, `/ja-jp/offers`.
- The gift-card catalog contains over 8,400 individual product pages following the pattern `/{locale}/online-gift-cards/{brand-slug}`. Gift card availability varies by region.
- Top-served locales include `en-us`, `en-in`, `en-ph`, `en-ae`, `en-au`, `en-br`, `en-gb`, `en-de`, `en-lk`, and `en-sa`.
